message: A parallel-chord Warren truss spans 12m, has a 2m height, and uses six 2m panels with aligned top and bottom nodes at every panel point. Provide a vertical at every panel point and alternating diagonals B0-T1, T1-B2, B2-T3, T3-B4, B4-T5, and T5-B6. Use a pin at B0 and a roller at B6. Apply an 8kN downward nodal load at each internal bottom-chord node B1 through B5 and run static analysis.
